item.title: Daily Minute — September 3, 2026
item.description:

item.title: Lesson 84: These are the ideas for today’s review:
item.description:
These are the ideas for today’s review: [67] “Love created me like Itself.”
I am in the likeness of my Creator. I cannot suffer, I cannot experience loss, and I cannot die. I am not a body. I would recognize my reality today.
